description: This file contains functions related to upgrading OpenMesh devices' firmware, including reading configuration parameters, flashing images to inactive memory partitions, and setting up U-Boot environment variables during an upgrade process.

methods.name: cfg_value_get
methods.description: Parses configuration content to extract a specified parameter value based on section and parameter name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_openmesh
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade procedures for OpenMesh devices, including flashing new images, updating environment variables, and setting boot sequences.
